Emily Chen: Heads up — 2 min to all-hands. Small agenda change: we'll push the roadmap deep-dive to after Q&A. Also the recorder didn't pick up last test. Ops @Alex K can you confirm recording + captions?
Alex K: On it. Ran `recorder status --room=allhands` — shows `ERROR: mic device not found` on recorder-2. Attempting soft-restart.
Alex K: Command I'm running: `ssh prod-recorder-2 'systemctl restart redwood-recorder'`
Ops Bot: Recording service restart triggered by Alex K at 2041234579. Status: restarting...
Mike R: Thanks. Leadership will take 10 min fewer slides — Jamal, we'll take your 2 roadmap Qs first.
Jamal Patel: @Mike R quick: is Dedicated GA target still end of Q3? Need to inform a customer.
Mike R: Yes GA target is end of Q3, still on track but shipping dependent on 2 infra items (autoscaler + KMS). We'll follow up offline with dates.
Ops Bot: Recording service status: UP. Recorder-2 streaming to s3://redwood-recordings/allhands/2041234567.mp4
Linda Gomez: Captions seemed off in the last test — check `caption-worker` queue. Alex can you bump latency to 3s? `caption-config set --latency 3s`
Alex K: Did that. Also swapped mic to backup room mic B. Quick check: does video+slides feed look ok for folks joining remote?
Vera: Video feed looks fine for me. Slides glitched at ~20s earlier but seem stable now.
Emily Chen: Great. @everyone reminder: post all-hands follow-up doc will be in #all-hands-docs, I'll DM slides after recording. If any blocking issues ping me.
Mike R: :thumbsup: see you in 2
